summary_1line: The Brahmana explains how the three gunas—Goodness, Passion, and Darkness—always coexist, shape beings and worlds, and determine spiritual ascent, stagnation, or decline.

image_candidates.scene_text: The rising sun shines over the earth as wicked men tremble in fear and weary travelers suffer under its burning heat.
A symbolic vision shows three intertwined forces—light, flame, and shadow—circling together within all creatures and objects of the world.
A contemplative sage meditates on the vast, dark unmanifest source from which the three qualities subtly arise and move through the universe.
